title: Holy Trinity Anglican Church
description: In 1924, the Hartland Cement Company began constructing the massive, steeply pitched gable roof of the Holy Trinity Anglican Church. Distinctive pointed arch recessed windows, later adorned with stained glass, added to the church's charm. Thanks to numerous volunteers, the building was completed and dedicated in 1925.
